title: Configuration encoding word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. For a natural number $s$, the encoding word is the concatenation of the encoded tape cells in the window determined by $s$, followed by the input-head position written as a binary list padded to width $w(|x|)$, and then a final true bit.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
A configuration $C$ of that machine on $x$
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the encoding of tape cells or the window, so those parts can only be described by their roles in the construction.
